name: shop-siren~p2
task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task is a single conditional rule ('Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off'), and the hard Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) expresses exactly that: every ringing step is followed by a switch toggle on that step or later. Grounding is correct — toggling the switch is the only way the siren stops — and since the siren is already off on the toggle step, the lasting condition closes cleanly with each toggle, so the Response never stays owed forever once the agent acts. No unconditional goal is commanded (the requirement only exists while the siren rings), so the empty FINAL_STATES with the rule-only warning is valid, and no Existence or extra order clause is needed.

texts: Each time the siren is ringing, the agent toggles the siren switch to turn it off.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u1, switch_toggled) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u1, switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
